text: The four consumed reads and the two handed-over operations of the pack are read as non-blocking and built against their fakes: the document index on API-P5-002 and the checklist on API-P5-008 of rwb-document, the case facts on API-P3-002 of rwb-case, the case-state announcement and the task raise on a published case contract whose two operation names are left as the placeholder, the LOV-LEGAL-TYPE and LOV-LEGAL-STATUS values as reference data read with their version, and the Litigation right of each operation declared on the operation and enforced at the edge for the screen path. The metadata rows of both stories are kept exactly as the plan gives them, with Contract, Integration and External dependencies None, and the two platform contracts of the pattern set (RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON) stay in the app story's build list.
why: The plan's dependency rows for this key name no contract, integration or external dependency while the story must reach the index, the case, the task and the right; DP-07 and DP-08 are not in its pattern set, and inventing a C or H row would change the plan's build sequence while reading a table directly would break DP-01 and DP-05. Recording the reads as consumed and faked keeps the metadata as the plan gives it and still lets the story start on Day 1.

text: The pack is derived and never persisted: it is composed on every read from the document index of rwb-document and the case facts of rwb-case, the assembly leaves no pack row and no pack column, and the persisted traces of an assembly are the decision record in rwb_litigation and the case state that rwb-case holds. The contract therefore declares the pack sub-shape as read-only elements of the legal-action answer and no pack table.
why: The Ownership Map gives this service legal_action and hearing only, TSD S4 T3.1 declares the same two objects, and the legacy Data block names no pack entity; adding a pack table would invent a table no owner holds and would need a DB story that the plan does not contain, while omitting the question would leave the central object of the key with no declared home.

text: NOTICE_BLOCKED, PACK_ASSEMBLY, PACK_VERIFIED and PACK_DEFECT_HOLD are states of the case of record and not values of legal_action.status: this service evaluates the rule, writes the decision record, announces the state fact with the rule ID and its version to rwb-case, and accepts the answer. No seventh value is added to LOV-LEGAL-STATUS, and the 1, 2, 3 and 5 working days of the rules are case-task service levels and not timers of this service.
why: LOV-LEGAL-STATUS has six members and none of the four states, TSD S4 T4 moves the four without naming the object that holds them, and the legacy criteria say in words that the case moves; treating them as case states keeps the only status list closed, keeps the case of record with its owner, and lets the story be built on Day 1 against the case fake.
